name: print-run
description: A team weighs two printers. The agent marks the open question, keeps a member's view without counting it, tells a member that a lead decides, records the lead's decision with the reason, and answers "why" from the record.
source: DESIGN.md section 6, A week at work, Monday

turns.text: are we going with Acme or Beacon for the print run?
Beacon were cheaper but Acme hit the date last time
Acme, the date matters more than 8%
Noa, why did we go with Acme?

1.note: lead decides: one marker line, no ballot

2.note: a member's view is kept, not counted
